IfcRepresentationItem() || IfcGeometricRepresentationItem () || IfcCurve() || IfcLine(Axis.Location, 
                   IfcRepresentationItem() || IfcGeometricRepresentationItem () || IfcVector(Axis.Z,1.0))

IFCSCHEDULETIMECONTROL.name: IfcScheduleTimeControl
inverse: ScheduleTimeControlAssigned : IfcRelAssignsTasks FOR TimeForTask

IFCSHAPEMODEL.name: IfcShapeModel
inverse: OfShapeAspect : SET [0:1] OF IfcShapeAspect FOR ShapeRepresentations

IFCSHAPEREPRESENTATION.name: IfcShapeRepresentation
whereRules:
WR22 : SIZEOF(QUERY(temp <* Items | 
               ('IFC2X3.IFCTOPOLOGICALREPRESENTATIONITEM' IN TYPEOF(temp))
                 AND (NOT(SIZEOF(
                   ['IFC2X3.IFCVERTEXPOINT',
                    'IFC2X3.IFCEDGECURVE',
                    'IFC2X3.IFCFACESURFACE'] * TYPEOF(temp)) = 1))
             )) = 0

IFCSLAB.name: IfcSlab
whereRules:
WR61 : NOT(EXISTS(PredefinedType)) OR
              (PredefinedType <> IfcSlabTypeEnum.USERDEFINED) OR
              ((PredefinedType = IfcSlabTypeEnum.USERDEFINED) AND EXISTS (SELF\IfcObject.ObjectType))

IFCSPACE.name: IfcSpace
inverse: HasCoverings : SET [0:?] OF IfcRelCoversSpaces FOR RelatedSpace
BoundedBy : SET [0:?] OF IfcRelSpaceBoundary FOR RelatingSpace

IFCSPACEHEATERTYPE.name: IfcSpaceHeaterType
whereRules:
WR1 : (PredefinedType <> IfcSpaceHeaterTypeEnum.USERDEFINED) OR
            ((PredefinedType = IfcSpaceHeaterTypeEnum.USERDEFINED) AND EXISTS(SELF\IfcElementType.ElementType))

IFCSPACEPROGRAM.name: IfcSpaceProgram
inverse: HasInteractionReqsFrom : SET [0:?] OF IfcRelInteractionRequirements FOR RelatedSpaceProgram
HasInteractionReqsTo : SET [0:?] OF IfcRelInteractionRequirements FOR RelatingSpaceProgram

IFCSPATIALSTRUCTUREELEMENT.name: IfcSpatialStructureElement
inverse: ReferencesElements : SET [0:?] OF IfcRelReferencedInSpatialStructure FOR RelatingStructure
ServicedBySystems : SET [0:?] OF IfcRelServicesBuildings FOR RelatedBuildings
ContainsElements : SET [0:?] OF IfcRelContainedInSpatialStructure FOR RelatingStructure
whereRules:
WR41 : (HIINDEX(SELF\IfcObjectDefinition.Decomposes) = 1) 
             AND
             ('IFC2X3.IFCRELAGGREGATES' IN TYPEOF(SELF\IfcObjectDefinition.Decomposes[1])) 
             AND
             (('IFC2X3.IFCPROJECT' IN TYPEOF (SELF\IfcObjectDefinition.Decomposes[1].RelatingObject)) OR
              ('IFC2X3.IFCSPATIALSTRUCTUREELEMENT' IN TYPEOF (SELF\IfcObjectDefinition.Decomposes[1].RelatingObject))
             )

IFCSTRUCTURALACTIVITY.name: IfcStructuralActivity
inverse: AssignedToStructuralItem : IfcRelConnectsStructuralActivity FOR RelatedStructuralActivity

IFCSTRUCTURALCONNECTION.name: IfcStructuralConnection
inverse: ConnectsStructuralMembers : SET [1:?] OF IfcRelConnectsStructuralMember FOR RelatedStructuralConnection

IFCSTRUCTURALITEM.name: IfcStructuralItem
inverse: AssignedStructuralActivity : SET [0:?] OF IfcRelConnectsStructuralActivity FOR RelatingElement

IFCSTRUCTURALLOADGROUP.name: IfcStructuralLoadGroup
inverse: SourceOfResultGroup : SET [0:1] OF IfcStructuralResultGroup FOR ResultForLoadGroup
LoadGroupFor : SET [0:?] OF IfcStructuralAnalysisModel FOR LoadedBy

IFCSTRUCTURALMEMBER.name: IfcStructuralMember
inverse: ReferencesElement : SET [0:?] OF IfcRelConnectsStructuralElement FOR RelatedStructuralMember
ConnectedBy : SET [0:?] OF IfcRelConnectsStructuralMember FOR RelatingStructuralMember

IFCSTRUCTURALREACTION.name: IfcStructuralReaction
inverse: Causes : SET [0:?] OF IfcStructuralAction FOR CausedBy

IFCSTRUCTURALRESULTGROUP.name: IfcStructuralResultGroup
inverse: ResultGroupFor : SET [0:1] OF IfcStructuralAnalysisModel FOR HasResults

IFCSTRUCTURALSURFACEMEMBERVARYING.name: IfcStructuralSurfaceMemberVarying
whereRules:
WR63 : SIZEOF(QUERY(temp <* SELF.VaryingThicknessLocation.ShapeRepresentations |
               NOT(('IFC2X3.IFCCARTESIANPOINT' IN TYPEOF(temp\IfcRepresentation.Items[1]))
                     OR
                   ('IFC2X3.IFCPOINTONSURFACE' IN TYPEOF(temp\IfcRepresentation.Items[1])))
               )) = 0

IFCSTRUCTUREDDIMENSIONCALLOUT.name: IfcStructuredDimensionCallout
whereRules:
WR31 : SIZEOF(QUERY ( Ato <* QUERY ( Con <* SELF.contents | (
                   'IFC2X3.IFCANNOTATIONTEXTOCCURRENCE' IN 
                    TYPEOF(Con)) ) | (NOT (Ato.Name IN ['dimension value',
                   'tolerance value','unit text','prefix text','suffix text']))))
                  = 0

IfcRepresentationItem() || IfcGeometricRepresentationItem () || IfcCurve() || IfcLine(AxisPosition.Location, 
                       IfcRepresentationItem() || IfcGeometricRepresentationItem () || IfcVector(AxisPosition.Z,1.0))

IFCSYSTEM.name: IfcSystem
inverse: ServicesBuildings : SET [0:1] OF IfcRelServicesBuildings FOR RelatingSystem

IFCTABLE.name: IfcTable
whereRules: WR1 : SIZEOF(QUERY( Temp <* Rows | HIINDEX(Temp.RowCells) <> HIINDEX(Rows[1].RowCells))) = 0
WR2 : SIZEOF(QUERY( Temp <* Rows | HIINDEX(Temp.RowCells) <> HIINDEX(Rows[1].RowCells))) = 0

IFCTABLEROW.name: IfcTableRow
inverse: OfTable : IfcTable FOR Rows

IFCTANKTYPE.name: IfcTankType
whereRules:
WR1 : (PredefinedType <> IfcTankTypeEnum.USERDEFINED) OR
            ((PredefinedType = IfcTankTypeEnum.USERDEFINED) AND EXISTS(SELF\IfcElementType.ElementType))

IFCTASK.name: IfcTask
whereRules: WR1 : SIZEOF(QUERY(temp <* SELF\IfcObjectDefinition.Decomposes | NOT('IFC2X3.IFCRELNESTS' IN TYPEOF(temp)))) = 0
WR2 : SIZEOF(QUERY(temp <* SELF\IfcObjectDefinition.IsDecomposedBy | NOT('IFC2X3.IFCRELNESTS' IN TYPEOF(temp)))) = 0

IFCTELECOMADDRESS.name: IfcTelecomAddress
whereRules:
WR1 : EXISTS (TelephoneNumbers) OR
            EXISTS (PagerNumber) OR
            EXISTS (FacsimileNumbers) OR 
            EXISTS (ElectronicMailAddresses) OR 
            EXISTS (WWWHomePageURL)

IFCTENDON.name: IfcTendon
whereRules: WR1 : (PredefinedType <> IfcTendonTypeEnum.USERDEFINED) OR ((PredefinedType = IfcTendonTypeEnum.USERDEFINED) AND EXISTS(SELF\IfcObject.ObjectType))

IFCTEXTURECOORDINATE.name: IfcTextureCoordinate
inverse: AnnotatedSurface : SET [1:1] OF IfcAnnotationSurface FOR TextureCoordinates

IFCTIMESERIES.name: IfcTimeSeries
inverse: DocumentedBy : SET [0:1] OF IfcTimeSeriesReferenceRelationship FOR ReferencedTimeSeries

IFCTUBEBUNDLETYPE.name: IfcTubeBundleType
whereRules:
WR1 : (PredefinedType <> IfcTubeBundleTypeEnum.USERDEFINED) OR
            ((PredefinedType = IfcTubeBundleTypeEnum.USERDEFINED) AND EXISTS(SELF\IfcElementType.ElementType))

IFCTYPEOBJECT.name: IfcTypeObject
inverse: ObjectTypeOf : SET [0:1] OF IfcRelDefinesByType FOR RelatingType

IFCUNITARYEQUIPMENTTYPE.name: IfcUnitaryEquipmentType
whereRules:
WR1 : (PredefinedType <> IfcUnitaryEquipmentTypeEnum.USERDEFINED) OR
            ((PredefinedType = IfcUnitaryEquipmentTypeEnum.USERDEFINED) AND EXISTS(SELF\IfcElementType.ElementType))

IFCVALVETYPE.name: IfcValveType
whereRules:
WR1 : (PredefinedType <> IfcValveTypeEnum.USERDEFINED) OR
            ((PredefinedType = IfcValveTypeEnum.USERDEFINED) AND EXISTS(SELF\IfcElementType.ElementType))

IFCVIBRATIONISOLATORTYPE.name: IfcVibrationIsolatorType
whereRules:
WR1 : (PredefinedType <> IfcVibrationIsolatorTypeEnum.USERDEFINED) OR
            ((PredefinedType = IfcVibrationIsolatorTypeEnum.USERDEFINED) AND EXISTS(SELF\IfcElementType.ElementType))

IFCWALLSTANDARDCASE.name: IfcWallStandardCase
whereRules:
WR1 : SIZEOF (QUERY(temp <* USEDIN(SELF, 'IFC2X3.IFCRELASSOCIATES.RELATEDOBJECTS') |
                          ('IFC2X3.IFCRELASSOCIATESMATERIAL' IN TYPEOF(temp)) AND
                          ('IFC2X3.IFCMATERIALLAYERSETUSAGE' IN TYPEOF(temp.RelatingMaterial))
                          )) = 1

IFCZONE.name: IfcZone
whereRules: WR1 : SIZEOF (QUERY (temp <* SELF\IfcGroup.IsGroupedBy.RelatedObjects |  NOT(('IFC2X3.IFCZONE' IN TYPEOF(temp)) OR ('IFC2X3.IFCSPACE' IN TYPEOF(temp))) )) = 0

IFCCOMPOUNDPLANEANGLEMEASURE.name: IfcCompoundPlaneAngleMeasure
whereRules: WR4 : ((SELF[1] >= 0) AND (SELF[2] >= 0) AND (SELF[3] >= 0)) OR ((SELF[1] <= 0) AND (SELF[2] <= 0) AND (SELF[3] <= 0))
